create.name: Danielle Dulsky
create.bio:
Danielle Dulsky is a writer, painter and practising witch whose teaching grows out of folklore, fairy tales, seasonal ritual and a love of Irish paganism. She trained as a painter at Arcadia University and has led women's circles, embodiment trainings, group spellwork and festivals of the turning year since 2007. Among her own teachers she names Clarissa Pinkola Estés, Bayo Akomolafe, and John Cantwell and Karen Ward of Slí An Chroí.

Through The Hag School, which she founded, she runs small online programmes for witches, mystics and writers: a year-long mythic witchcraft apprenticeship, monthly membership covens built around the full moon and writing as spellcraft, self-paced journeys through myth and art, and long writing intensives on personal myth. Her approach treats story as a way of meeting the sacred, using old tales, goddess myths and archetypes as maps for a person's own life, with writing, ritual, visualisation and gentle movement. She has written eight books, mostly with New World Library, among them Woman Most Wild, The Holy Wild, Bones & Honey, The Night House and The Book of Wild Daughters, and she teaches weekend workshops at Omega. She divides her time between a Pennsylvania steel town and upstate New York.

books.title: Woman Most Wild: Three Keys to Liberating the Witch Within
books.author: Danielle Dulsky
books.description: Her first book, an invitation into a nature-based, non-religious women's spirituality built on ritual, sensuality, magick and sisterhood. It reclaims the word witch and is arranged around three 'keys' for leaving the broom closet.

books.title: The Holy Wild: A Heathen Bible for the Untamed Woman
books.author: Danielle Dulsky
books.description: Written in the style of scripture, this book offers verses, stories and rituals arranged by the elements for women seeking a wilder, earth-centred faith. Bayo Akomolafe wrote the foreword.

books.title: Seasons of Moon and Flame: The Wild Dreamer’s Epic Journey of Becoming
books.author: Danielle Dulsky
books.description: A journey through the wheel of the year in the company of the hag, the crone figure of folklore, with stories, rituals and prompts for each season. Mat Auryn wrote the foreword.

books.title: The Holy Wild Grimoire: A Heathen Handbook of Magick, Spells, and Verses
books.author: Danielle Dulsky
books.description: A working companion to The Holy Wild, introducing her mythic approach to witchcraft through spells, verses, rituals and journal prompts for finding your own purpose.

books.title: Bones & Honey: A Heathen Prayer Book
books.author: Danielle Dulsky
books.description: A book of short prayers and blessings for witches and wanderers, written for everyday moments as well as the hard times we live in.

books.title: The Night House: Folklore, Fairy Tales, Rites, and Magick for the Wise and Wild
books.author: Danielle Dulsky
books.description: A course in old stories, treating fairy tales and folklore as living stores of wisdom and magick. Each tale is paired with rites and reflections for applying its lessons to your own life.

books.title: The Book of Wild Daughters: Folklore for the Feminine Journey
books.author: Danielle Dulsky
books.description: Her newest book, drawing on folklore and the figure of the 'wild daughter'. It guides readers to find the personal myth they are living through story, writing and ritual. Published April 2027 and on pre-order now.

courses.title: Wild Daughters
courses.description: A weekend at Omega's Rhinebeck campus on finding the mythic story of your own life. Through fairy tales, goddess myths and folklore, plus writing, ceremony, visualisation and light movement, participants trace their own patterns and mark transitions with simple rituals.
courses.price: Member $445 USD, standard $495 USD (tuition; accommodation extra)

courses.title: Book of the Bone-Woman: A 13-Week Writing Intensive
courses.description: A thirteen-week online programme from Imbolc to Beltane for people writing a book rooted in personal myth and old stories. It runs in a small group of nineteen with live immersions, prompts and feedback.
courses.price: $1,800 USD paid in full, or five monthly payments of $400 USD

courses.title: The Hidden House: A Mystery Coven for the Wyrd & Wise
courses.description: A monthly online membership built around a full-moon gathering, with ritual, writing as spellcraft, divination and seasonal work led by Danielle.

courses.title: Witches of the Word: A Sharing Coven for Poets, Storytellers, and Word-Witches
courses.description: A loosely facilitated online community where writing meets witchcraft. Members get weekly moon-themed prompts, rituals for writers, recorded writing classes and a place to share work.

courses.title: The Bone-Witch’s Heathen Imaginaria
courses.description: A self-paced journey of twelve lessons, sent every five days, through myth and imagination. Each lesson moves through visual story, an art ritual, a sigil, song and writing prompts.

courses.title: Heathen Imaginarium Wilderness Guide Training
courses.description: A downloadable curriculum for leading others through the twelve-story Heathen Imaginarium journey, with teaching materials, videos, ready-made images and group calls with Danielle and Lynae.

Book of the Bone-Woman dates: live immersion dates on the page are 5 Feb, 12 Mar and 30 Apr 2027; I used 5 Feb to 30 Apr 2027 as start and end.
The Book of Wild Daughters is a pre-order (out 6 April 2027).
The website photo is a styled portrait with an antler crown; the Omega headshot is first.
